paragraphs: - — ^ Q ■ Having completed the fourteen years (of exile), the selfcontrolled elder brother of Lakshmana, arriving at the hermitage of Varadwlya on the fifth day, saluted the ascetic. And bowing unto Varadwaya, having asceticism for his wealth, he said,— 1 “O thou gifted with six sorts of wealth, hast thou heard of the prosperity and well being (of my city)? Is Bharata still engaged (in guarding the people) ? Are my mothers living ?” Being thus addressed by R&ma the great ascetic VaradwSya replied, delighted, and smiling, unto that foremost of Raghus, — “Abiding by thy command and with matted locks, Bharata is waiting for thee, always honoring thy sandals. And all others are well in thy house.

O subduer of thy enemies, I was greatly pained, when I saw thee before entering the huge forest, wearing bark, three with thy wife,* deprived of thy kingdom for piety only, RAMA YANA . walking on foot, renouncing every thing, obeying th« command of thy sire, deprived of all comforts, like a celestial banished from heaven, deprived of thy kingdom at the words of Kaikeyi, and living on wild roots and fruits $ but beholding thee now of accomplished end, with all thy friends having vanquished the enemy, I have attained to highest delight. O R&ghava, I am apprised of immense griefs and happinesses which befell thee when thou didst live in Janasth&na. Thy blameless spouse was carried away stealthily by R&vana engaged as thou wert in the behoof of the Br5hmanas,and in the protection of all the ascetics.

The view of MSricha — the carrying away of Sit&, — the beholding of the headless demon, — thy going to (the lake) PampSL,— thy friendship with Sugriva, where VSLli was slain by thee, — the enquiry of Vaidehi undertaken by the son of Wind-god, — the construction of the bridge by Nala after the whereabouts of Vaidehi had been known — the conflagration of Lank& by the delighted and the leading monkeys — the destruction, in the conflict, of Havana proud of his own strength, along with his sons, friends, courtiers, army and steeds — the arrival of the celestials on the destruction of Havana, the thorn of gods and the grant of boon by them— -I have known all these by virtue of my asceticism, G thou fond of virtue.

My flisciples used t© go hence to that city to bring tidings, I shall even* now grant thee a boon, O foremost of those using weapons. Do thou accept my Arghya* and then repair to AyodhySL to-morrow.” And respectfully abiding by his words, that effulgent son of the king, delighted, begged of him the boon. “O thou gifted with six qualities, on my way while proceeding to AyodhyS, let all the trees, bearing fruits out of season, and producing honey, bear many a nectar-smelling fulfilled” than all the trees there became like those of heaven. dowers &c with water in a small boat-shaped vessel. 152$ Trees without fruits were filled therewith and trees without flowers were covered with them. AH the trees, whose leaves were dried up, were enveloped with foliage and all of them began to pour honey. The way to Ayodhya for three Yoyanas was thus filled all over (with trees). Thereupon thousands of monkeys, living, at pleasure and delightedly, -on various celestial fruits, thought as if they were in heaven.

verses.sa:
पूर्णे चतुर्दशे वर्षे पञ्चम्यां लक्ष्मणाग्रजः।
भरद्वाजाश्रमं प्राप्य ववन्दे नियतो मुनिम् ॥

सोऽपृच्छदभिवाद्यैनं भरद्वाजं तपोधनम्।
शृणोषि कच्चिद् भगवन् सुभिक्षानामयं पुरे।
कच्चित् स युक्तो भरतो जीवन्त्यपि च मातरः ॥

एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरद्वाजो महामुनिः।
प्रत्युवाच रघुश्रेष्ठं स्मितपूर्वं प्रहृष्टवत् ॥

आज्ञावशत्वे भरतो जटिलस्त्वां प्रतीक्षते।
पादुके ते पुरस्कृत्य सर्वं च कुशलं गृहे ॥

त्वां पुरा चीरवसनं प्रविशन्तं महावनम्।
स्त्रीतृतीयं च्युतं राज्याद् धर्मकामं च केवलम् ॥

पदातिं त्यक्तसर्वस्वं पितृनिर्देशकारिणम्।
सर्वभोगैः परित्यक्तं स्वर्गच्युतमिवामरम् ॥

दृष्ट्वा तु करुणापूर्वं ममासीत् समितिंजय।
कैकेयीवचने युक्तं वन्यमूलफलाशिनम् ॥

साम्प्रतं तु समृद्धार्थं समित्रगणबान्धवम्।
समीक्ष्य विजितारिं च ममाभूत् प्रीतिरुत्तमा ॥

सर्वं च सुखदुःखं ते विदितं मम राघव।
यत् त्वया विपुलं प्राप्तं जनस्थाननिवासिना ॥

ब्राह्मणार्थे नियुक्तस्य रक्षतः सर्वतापसान्।
रावणेन हृता भार्या बभूवेयमनिन्दिता ॥

मारीचदर्शनं चैव सीतोन्मथनमेव च।
कबन्धदर्शनं चैव पम्पाभिगमनं तथा ॥

सुग्रीवेण च ते सख्यं यत्र वाली हतस्त्वया।
मार्गणं चैव वैदेह्याः कर्म वातात्मजस्य च ॥

विदितायां च वैदेह्यां नलसेतुर्यथा कृतः।
यथा चादीपिता लङ्का प्रहृष्टैर्हरियूथपैः ॥

सपुत्रबान्धवामात्यः सबलः सहवाहनः।
यथा च निहतः संख्ये रावणो बलदर्पितः ॥

यथा च निहते तस्मिन् रावणे देवकण्टके।
समागमश्च त्रिदशैर्यथा दत्तश्च ते वरः ॥

सर्वं ममैतद् विदितं तपसा धर्मवत्सल।
सम्पतन्ति च मे शिष्याः प्रवृत्त्याख्याः पुरीमितः ॥

अहमप्यत्र ते दद्मि वरं शस्त्रभृतां वर।
अर्घ्यं प्रतिगृहाणेदमयोध्यां श्वो गमिष्यसि ॥

तस्य तच्छिरसा वाक्यं प्रतिगृह्य नृपात्मजः।
बाढमित्येव संहृष्टः श्रीमान् वरमयाचत ॥

अकालफलिनो वृक्षाः सर्वे चापि मधुस्रवाः।
फलान्यमृतगन्धीनि बहूनि विविधानि च ॥

भवन्तु मार्गे भगवन्नयोध्यां प्रति गच्छतः।
तथेति च प्रतिज्ञाते वचनात् समनन्तरम् ॥

अभवन् पादपास्तत्र स्वर्गपादपसंनिभाः।
निष्फलाः फलिनश्चासन् विपुष्पाः पुष्पशालिनः ॥

शुष्काः समग्रपत्रास्ते नगाश्चैव मधुस्रवाः।
सर्वतो योजनास्तिस्रो गच्छतामभवंस्तदा ॥

ततः प्रहृष्टाः प्लवगर्षभास्ते
बहूनि दिव्यानि फलानि चैव।
कामादुपाश्नन्ति सहस्रशस्ते
मुदान्विताः स्वर्गजितो यथैव ॥
